import subprocess
import json

def act(turn, move):

    cmd = ["python3", "/app/act.py", payload]
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    out = json.loads(res.stdout)
    print(f"Frame {out.get('frame')}: turn={turn}, move={move}, status={out.get('status')}, col={out.get('collision')}, img={out.get('image')}")
    return out

    (45, 0.0),   # 99
    (45, 0.0),   # 100
]

print(f"Executing {len(actions)} actions...")
for turn, move in actions:
    act(turn, move)
